context: Hina-young proudly shows Asuka a passing grade on her math test.
purpose: Student sharing success with kind teacher.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 先生、数学受かりました!
lines.style: Bright, immediate delight. Attack on the first word with a lift. Warm and sunny throughout. No hesitation—pure joy breaking through.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: Oh, you really worked hard for that!
lines.style: Soft, genuinely delighted. Warm recognition without exaggeration. A slight pause before the praise lands—the moment of seeing the effort clearly.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: My score went up from last time.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Speaking matter-of-factly but with an undercurrent of relief and joy. Modest tempo, letting the accomplishment speak for itself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: Hard work really does pay off, doesn't it.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing tone. A small smile in the voice. Speaking from experience, not lecturing. Slow, steady pace that lets the wisdom settle in.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright burst of genuine joy. Quick, light attack. Warm and open all the way through. Letting the happiness shine without performing it.
